name: Implementing Ideas LLC
old_description: Discover why industry leaders entrust their vision to Implementing Ideas – where expertise meets innovation, ensuring unparalleled electronic solutions.
about:
Implementing Ideas LLC operates from Orem, Utah. The company was founded by David (last name not publicly disclosed) and provides electronics manufacturing services to a range of industries.

The shop delivers full-service printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) covering rapid prototyping through high-volume production, custom cable and wire harness assembly with precision termination and testing, and upper assembly that integrates PCBAs with mechanical components for box-build-ready solutions. A dedicated Kickstarter program offers no-minimum-order prototyping and seamless scaling to production.

Customers span biomedical, defense (Army), commercial, automation, startup, and data-wiring sectors. The company cites a case study with Schläger Sensors and testimonials from clients such as Brad Huber, Rich Mouritsen, Joshua Webber, and Andy Loveless.

Implementing Ideas emphasizes on-time delivery, cutting-edge technology, and a customer-focused approach. It holds dual ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 certifications, underscoring a commitment to quality and aerospace-grade processes. The quality policy page highlights these certifications and the Schläger Sensors case study, reflecting a focus on high-reliability applications.
